description.zh: 当身份类型是CLIENT时，指定设备的ClientID。
description.en: The client ID if you set IdentityType to CLIENT.

description.zh:
身份类型。

- USER：仅用户名。

- CLIENT：具体到客户端。
description.en:
The identity type. Valid values:

*   USER
*   CLIENT

description.zh: 云消息队列 MQTT 版实例的 ID。
description.en: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for MQTT instance.

description.zh: 签名校验方式，ORIGIN：原始值比较，即比较password与secret，SIGNED： 对clientId进行HmacSHA1加签（使用secret，参考签名模式）验证，然后比较password。
description.en: The signature verification mode. ORIGIN: compares the password and the AccessKey secret. SIGNED: uses the HMAC_SHA1 algorithm to sign the client ID to obtain a password and then compares the password.
The username. The value cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun onsmqtt update-custom-auth-identity --instance-id post-1110000 --username test --secret xxxx --identity-type USER --client-id GID_test@@@test --sign-mode SIGNED --api-version 2020-04-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun onsmqtt UpdateCustomAuthIdentity --region cn-hangzhou --Secret xxxx --IdentityType USER --InstanceId 'post-1110000' --Username test --SignMode SIGNED --ClientId 'GID_test@@@test'
